title: AINM Protocol - Threading Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for thread management: creation, sub-threading, participants, presence, and mentions. See threading.md.

ThreadCreateParams.description: Parameters for ainm.thread.create. Creates a root thread or sub-thread. See threading.md Section 3.4.

thread_id.description: UUIDv7 identifying the thread. Generated client-side by the creator. Server validates uniqueness.

title.description: Human-readable thread title. Informational only -- not used for routing or identification.

participants.description: Array of AINM addresses for initial thread participants. MUST include the creator's own address.

metadata.description: Optional extensible metadata for the thread.

ThreadMetadata.description: Thread metadata structure. Every thread carries this data. See threading.md Section 3.3.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) of when the thread was created. Set by the server.

created_by.description: AINM address of the thread creator.

parent_thread_id.description: UUIDv7 of the parent thread. null for root threads, non-null for sub-threads.

parent_message_id.description: UUIDv7 of the parent message from which this sub-thread branches. null for root threads.

participants.description: Array of participant records with identity, type, joined_at, and role.

ThreadParticipant.description: A participant record within a thread. See threading.md Section 3.3.

type.description: Participant type. Resolved from the identity record (identity.md Section 4.3).

joined_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) of when the participant joined the thread.

role.description: Thread role. 'creator' for the thread creator (exactly one per thread), 'member' for all others. Both roles have equal messaging capabilities.

SubThreadCreateParams.description: Parameters for creating a sub-thread. Uses ainm.thread.create with parent references. One-level nesting only. See threading.md Section 4.

parent_thread_id.description: UUIDv7 of the parent root thread. MUST reference a root thread (not a sub-thread). Per Phase 1 decision: one-level nesting only.

parent_message_id.description: UUIDv7 of the message in the parent thread from which this sub-thread branches.

participants.description: Initial sub-thread participants. MUST include the creator's address. Participants must be members of the parent thread or new invitees.

PresenceUpdate.description: Presence update for a participant within a thread. Thread-scoped -- a participant has independent presence per thread. See threading.md Section 8.

thread_id.description: The thread this presence update applies to. Per Phase 1 decision: thread-scoped presence.

identity.description: The participant whose presence is being updated.

status.description: Presence status. Human states: online, offline, away, dnd. Agent states: available, busy, processing, offline. Combined enum for schema validation.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail about the presence state (e.g., 'Analyzing code for potential bugs').

MentionEvent.description: Notification that a participant was @-mentioned in a thread message. See threading.md Section 9.

by.description: The participant who sent the message containing the mention.

ThreadErrorCodes.description: Thread-specific JSON-RPC error codes in the range -32030 to -32039. See threading.md Section 10.

codes.description: Error code definitions for threading errors.

-32030.description: Thread creation failed. Used for duplicate thread_id, nested sub-thread attempt, or invalid parent references.

-32031.description: The identity is already a member of the thread.

-32024.description: The referenced thread does not exist.

-32025.description: The identity is not a member of the thread.
